root: ^ugghhhhhhh…. What the hell is wrong with me?
^Oh good evening madam.. I was just doing some.. Soul searching

^My entire life I’ve been told that the lower classes were worse. Simply inferior to us nobles and that it was our job as the Miraults to give even a modicum of luxury to them so they wouldn’t be as “filthy”.

^I used to eat it up, we had more money after all. What did it matter what they thought? *Chuckle*... But look at me now. I have one regular here and she’s one of the people I was always told to hate. And not only that, she's the only person here trying to better this damn place. What a joke..
^There’s been a small rumor going around. You’re not going down there for just wealth are you?
^You don't need to tell me. I don't exactly deserve it. I just wanted to say sorry, for uh- being an asshole.
^Heh.. Well from the look of things your family sounds far worse. Apology accepted.
